Title: General availability: Assessments for migration to Azure VMware Solution

Body.Content:
As part of customers’ migration journey to Azure, they assess their on-premises workloads to measure cloud readiness, identify risks, and estimate costs and complexity. Azure VMware Solution empowers you to seamlessly extend or migrate your existing on-premises VMware applications to Azure without the cost, effort, or risk of re-architecting applications or retooling operations. We are announcing that assessments for migration to Azure VMware Solution is now generally available.

Learn more.
